response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise required for this role; his work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only a brief, undetailed mention of Java in past roles without context on IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Strong full-stack and systems engineering background across diverse platforms
Proven experience building developer tooling and open-source projects
Excellent communication and workshop leadership in technical communities
concerns: No demonstrable recent or deep work with Java/Kotlin or Spring ecosystem
Lack of evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or JVM optimization experience
Primary tech stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) diverges significantly from JVM-focused role
